nodes.title: Avionics parts on arrival: weigh, measure, confirm the CoreWing stack split
nodes.procedure: 0.01 g scale on every AVN part; calipers on FC board, airspeed board (incl. ports), RX, GPS, probe OD; confirm the FC top board runs from the power board on a cable (else fallback: whole stack on the PDB plate on gel cubes, 8 AWG leads with a 30 mm flex loop tied to the tray); confirm which board carries the output pads 1-6 and the Vx rail and that Vx is not on the GH-6 link (CR-F1-29; if the outputs are on the power board, E-HRN-22/24-29 end on PWR-003 and F2 re-routes); record the connector positions for F2; update subsystems/avionics/params.json and re-run avn_data.py
